title: UPI payment fails for high value transaction
description: Payment fails when a customer attempts a UPI transfer above the configured transaction limit.

title: High value UPI transfer unsuccessful
description: UPI transfer is unsuccessful for transactions above the supported amount threshold.

title: UPI payment timeout after submit
description: The payment request times out after the user submits a UPI transaction.

title: UPI transaction times out on slow network
description: UPI payment does not complete when network latency is high and eventually shows a timeout.

title: Login fails with valid credentials
description: Users cannot sign in even though the username and password are valid.

title: Valid user credentials rejected
description: The application rejects correct login credentials and keeps the user on the sign-in page.

title: Account locked after failed attempts
description: User account becomes locked after multiple incorrect password attempts.

title: Password reset email not received
description: Password reset request succeeds but the user does not receive the reset email.

title: Payment succeeds but status remains pending
description: The payment is completed but the transaction status continues to show pending.

title: Completed payment displayed as pending
description: After a successful transaction the UI incorrectly shows the payment as pending.

title: Refund not reflected in account balance
description: A completed refund is not reflected in the customer's available account balance.

title: Refund amount missing from balance
description: The refunded amount does not appear in the customer's account balance.

title: Statement download fails
description: Downloading the account statement results in an error.

title: Account statement PDF cannot be downloaded
description: The user cannot download the statement PDF from the account page.

title: Chatbot gives incorrect account balance
description: The banking chatbot displays an incorrect available balance for the customer.

title: Virtual assistant shows wrong balance
description: The virtual assistant returns a balance that does not match the account balance.

title: Chatbot fails to connect customer to agent
description: The chatbot does not transfer the customer to a live agent after the customer requests human assistance.

title: Live agent transfer unavailable from chatbot
description: Requesting a human representative from the chatbot does not start the agent handoff.

title: Search results missing recent transactions
description: The transaction search does not return transactions created recently.

title: Recent transactions not visible in search
description: Newly completed transactions are missing from transaction search results.
